title: Find social media profiles by username
description: Enter a username and we find the matching profiles across 900+ sites, ranked by confidence. Just the handle is needed - everything else is optional.

username.title: Username
username.description: The handle to search, for example elonmusk. Enter just the handle - paste an @handle or a profile link like twitter.com/elonmusk and we clean it down to the handle. Comma-separate to search several at once: johndoe, janedoe.

mode.title: Scan depth
mode.description: How deep to scan. Fast probes the top sites quickly (about 30s for 100 sites) and is best for most runs. Slow reads each page for more detail. Special pulls extra OSINT signals.
mode.sectionDescription: Control how wide and deep the search goes, and how it is filtered. The defaults work well for most runs.

top.title: How many sites to scan
top.description: Scan the top N most popular sites. 100 is about 30s, 500 about 3 minutes, 900 is full coverage.

websites.title: Specific sites only (optional)
websites.description: Scan only these specific sites instead of going by popularity. Leave empty to use 'How many sites to scan' above.

countries.title: Filter by country (optional)
countries.description: Only scan sites based in these countries. Leave empty to search globally.

siteType.title: Filter by site category (optional)
siteType.description: Only scan one category of site. Leave on Any for no filter.

method.title: What to return
method.description: Found accounts only is the cleanest. The other options also include misses, which is useful for research.

filter.title: Confidence threshold
filter.description: How sure a match must be to count. High confidence is the cleanest and is recommended.

extract.title: Pull emails & links from found profiles
extract.description: Pulls emails, links and other patterns out of each detected profile.
extract.sectionDescription: Less common options. The defaults are fine for most runs.

metadata.title: Add page metadata (name, bio, image)
metadata.description: Adds each profile's page title, description, image and language.

trim.title: Trim long text fields
trim.description: Trims very long text fields for cleaner output. Recommended.

timeout.title: Time limit (seconds)
timeout.description: Stop the scan after this many seconds and return whatever was found. Default 1800 (30 minutes).
